added.summary: --tcg-* roles for the card family (CardFace, CardHand, CardPiles, CardCollection, CardDeckList, CardReward): each type's colour and its type-line ink, the face's cut, glass, wash and rim, the art window over its rarity's glow, the hexagon cost gem, the name plate and text recess, dimming for unplayable and unowned cards (art and frame only), the reason tag, card backs and count tags, the deck list's type rail and steps, the relic plate and the fade of a strip that scrolls sideways.
New prop dim: dims the art and the frame of a card that cannot be played or is not owned, never its words.
New row field cards.reason: the game's words for an unplayable card (No energy), shown on a tag at the card's head, above any Play plate; empty reads Cannot be played. New part CardHand.reason.

New row field filters.count (shown beside the filter's label) and string card.collection.notInDeck; card.collection.inDeck reads In deck ×{count}. New parts CardCollection.count, .owned, .deck, .reason.
New prop kicker (a small line over the title). New parts CardReward.kicker, .mark, .kind, .name, .text, .bracket. A relic's kind line shows its typeLabel when the game gives one.

breaking.change: The face is redrawn: a frame cut at two corners and rimmed in its type's colour, the art window over its rarity's glow, the name on a plate, a tinted type line, the rules text in a recess (up to four lines, fewer on a short face, each ending whole with an ellipsis) and a hexagon cost gem. CardFace.headline, .label and .caption are gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardFace.headline dresses CardFace.name; CardFace.label and .caption dress CardFace.type.

breaking.change: An unplayable card dims its art and frame and says why on a tag at its head instead of a lock badge. CardHand.badge is gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardHand.badge dresses CardHand.reason; a game passes its reason on each row.

breaking.change: A pile is a stack of card backs (one when empty) with its icon on top and the count on a cut tag at its corner. CardPiles.cell, .figure and .badge are gone; CardPiles.stack is new.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardPiles.cell dresses CardPiles.pile; .figure and .badge dress CardPiles.count.

breaking.change: Each card shows its owned count on its corner, In deck ×N or Not in deck under it and, when the game will not add it, the reason under that; the selected card wears brackets; an unowned card is hatched and dimmed while its name keeps its ink. The filters are an underline strip that scrolls with a fade. CardCollection.badge is gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardCollection.badge dresses CardCollection.owned, .deck or .reason.

breaking.change: A row carries its card type as a rail on the leading edge, the cost in a hexagon, ×copies and square steps; the size is a leaning bar. CardDeckList.figure, .label, .cell, .caption, .track and .fill are gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardDeckList.figure dresses CardDeckList.copies or .cost; .track and .fill dress CardDeckList.size.

breaking.change: Offers sit in one row with brackets on the one looked at; a relic is a gold plate with its mark in a diamond. On a phone one offer shows at nearly full width with its text whole and the next peeking at a faded edge, scrolling sideways. CardReward.cell, .well, .headline and .caption are gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardReward.cell dresses CardReward.choice or .relic; .well dresses CardReward.mark; .headline dresses CardReward.name; .caption dresses CardReward.kind or .text.
